data.action: 温泉池边裹单薄浴巾回眸浅笑
data.camera: intimate medium shot, bright sunshine, steam and snow
data.description: 【三笠 · 雪霁晴空露天温泉单薄浴巾】雪后放晴的露天温泉池畔，阳光明媚，三笠仅裹单薄浴巾倚靠池石，红围巾垂于肩头，温热泉水浸润着她曼妙优美的人体线条，水珠顺着精致锁骨滚落，雪景阳光映衬下双颊绯红。
data.lighting: 雪地天然反光与晨阳金辉
data.promptProse: Mikasa leans on the pool stone, holding her towel at her chest and smiling back, red scarf over her shoulders. Sun and snow-reflected light brighten the steam.
data.title: 三笠 · 雪霁晴空露天温泉单薄浴巾
data.animaCaption: She holds the towel at her chest with the scarf over her shoulders.
